main_issue: How to adapt the weeknight dinner rota when Agent D must be vegetarian for a month: whether D cooks their own food on others' nights or everyone eats the same meal.

A-B.evidence: A insists on sharing the same meal (T7, T9, T13); B says 'as long as we all eat at 6.30' (T10) and proposes D cooks own food (T20); A concedes 'If that's what everyone wants' (T23).

A-C.evidence: C refuses to cook two meals (T5) and agrees with B (T21); A objects to separate cooking (T7, T9) but then accepts (T23).

A-D.evidence: A objects that D cooking separately isn't shared (T7, T9, T13) and D offers to cook on his night (T8) and recipes (T19); D finally accepts own food on others' nights (T22) and A reluctantly accepts (T23).

B-C.evidence: C agrees with B's concern about two meals; C says 'I agree with Agent B' (T21) on D cooking own food.

B-D.evidence: B asks if two meals needed (T4); B proposes D cooks own food 'like he said at first' (T20); D agrees (T22).

C-D.evidence: C won't cook two meals (T5); D reassures he'll cook his own (T6); C agrees with that plan (T21), D accepts (T22).
